'''Ancient Corellian''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]]. Alongside [[Coruscanti (language)|Coruscanti]], Ancient Corellian was one of the most influential languages that [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] was derived from.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> [[Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII]] could speak the language.<ref name="Vandelhelm">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040304vandelhelm|text=Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys|int=Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys}}</ref>
